    Set CSS grid item placement on a UI element

    grid_item.Rd

    Adds grid item CSS properties to a tag element.

    grid_item(
  ui,
  area = NULL,
  row_start = NULL,
  row_end = NULL,
  column_start = NULL,
  column_end = NULL,
  align_self = NULL,
  justify_self = NULL
)

    Arguments

    ui

    A tag object to modify.

    area

    CSS grid-area value (e.g., a named area from grid-template-areas).

    row_start

    CSS grid-row-start value.

    row_end

    CSS grid-row-end value.

    column_start

    CSS grid-column-start value.

    column_end

    CSS grid-column-end value.

    align_self

    CSS align-self value.

    justify_self

    CSS justify-self value.

    Value

    The modified tag with grid styles appended.

    Examples

    grid_item(shiny::div("Sidebar content"), area = "sidebar")
#> <div style="grid-area:sidebar;">Sidebar content</div>

grid_item(shiny::div("Spanning item"), column_start = 1, column_end = 3)
#> <div style="grid-column:1 / 3;">Spanning item</div>
